summary: Focused retest of Officer console handicap columns fix. Independently verified end-to-end via UI: PY handicap race shows Elapsed & Corrected columns, position is a read-only SPAN (data-testid=pos-input-<sail>) for FINISHED rows, and 'auto-calculated' note is visible. Corrected-time ordering is correct — Slow (PN1300, elapsed 1:12:00, corrected 55:23) is Pos 1 ahead of Fast (PN900, elapsed 1:00:00, corrected 1:06:40) even though Fast finished first on the water. Fleet class regression also verified: NO Elapsed/Corrected columns, pos-input-<sail> remains an editable INPUT, and 3 taps in order produce positions 1,2,3. No 'auto-calculated' note on fleet.
critical_code_review_comments: Officer.jsx line 118: `const handicap = meta.scoring_type === 'irc' || meta.scoring_type === 'py'` — this is a fine boolean now that both sides are explicit comparisons. (Previous iteration had a bug `=== 'irc' || 'py'` which always evaluated truthy.) Verified fixed.

Officer.jsx renders read-only span with same data-testid=pos-input-<sail> as the fleet input — good for test parity, but consumers must inspect tagName (SPAN vs INPUT) to distinguish. Documented in this iteration's tests.
Fleet race header does NOT include an explicit 'ranked on tap order' hint — minor UX nice-to-have, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — handicap columns, read-only positions, note, corrected-time ordering, fleet regression all pass

test_credentials: Admin PIN admin2026, Officer PIN sail2026 via POST /api/auth/login
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Playwright test created TEST_PY_*, TEST_FL_* classes/series/boats/races and deleted them all in the finally block. CLEANUP OK printed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Officer console handicap UI is fully wired. If regressions arise, reuse the flow: seed via API (POST /api/classes with scoring_type=py|irc, POST /api/boats with rating + helm required, POST /api/series with schedule, POST /api/races, /select-boats, /finish with finish_time as ISO WITH tz-offset like 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00' — naive datetimes break _recompute_handicap on the server), then open the race via /officer route (data-testid=race-item-<id>) and inspect the 'Provisional results & penalties' table: th list should include 'Elapsed' and 'Corrected' for handicap; pos-input-<sail> tagName must be SPAN for FINISHED handicap rows and INPUT for fleet rows.
rca of the issue: Previously (iteration_4) Officer.jsx computed but never used the `handicap` flag, so IRC/PY races displayed a fleet-style editable position input and no Elapsed/Corrected columns. Main agent has now wired the flag around the provisional table headers, position cell (span vs Input), Elapsed cell (fmtDur(r.elapsed_seconds)), Corrected cell (fmtDur(r.corrected_seconds)) and the auto-calculated note. Confirmed by independent Playwright test — see screenshot /tmp/py.png showing Pos 1: Slow S5341 · 1300 with Elapsed 1:12:00 and Corrected 55:23; Pos 2: Fast F5341 · 900 with 1:00:00 / 1:06:40.
